notes.title: Dev update
notes.notes:
Hey all, I figured I'd make a post explaining a few things since I've been a bit quiet lately.

I'm currently working on updating a lot of boring behind the scenes stuff for DDI Rally. Game engine updates, graphics pipeline updates etc, hence why there's been nothing to show. I've been testing new foliage and things like that.

I'll have more news as soon as there's something newsworthy, in the meantime rest assured I'm working on this and SRGP, they're not abandoned as you internet people love to scream about. ;)

notes.title: Patch notes for v0.0.7
notes.notes:
Wheel and Pedals are now supported along with Force feedback & basic telemetry output for dashboards.

[u][b]Setup[/b][/u]
In order to receive force feedback you'll need to install the [url=https://www.logitechg.com/en-gb/innovation/g-hub.html]Logitech G Hub[/url] [i][b]even if you're not using a Logitech wheel[/b][/i].

For some wheels the game will recognise you're using a wheel and set the input accordingly (this enables a direct input from the wheel to the vehicle steering - unlike the default smoothed values for controllers). If your wheel isn't detected you can force enable wheel mode in the Settings>Gameplay menu. Even if you're not using a wheel, wheel mode provides a direct input to the vehicle steering which is what you may prefer. Try it!

[u][b]Mappings[/b][/u]
Again, some wheels are detected and a basic map is applied, but it's best to enter the control mapper and set this up how you want it.

[u][b]Deadzone[/b][/u]
By default, there's a small deadzone on analogue inputs, you may want to remove this for the steering wheel. Click the calibrate button in the control mapper and set the deadzone to 0.

[u][b]Controls not working?[/b][/u]
If you find your controls are not working as expected, close the game & please go to:

[i]Users\[user name]\AppData\LocalLow\Dangerous Derk Interactive\DDI Rally Championship[/i]

and delete the [b]input.ddi[/b] file. This will revert your input back to default. [b]Please note that clicking the defaults button in the control mapper[/b] [i][b]does not have the same effect.[/b][/i]
